== Notes ==
* This skill only recharges [[Resurrection Signet]], [[Sunspear Rebirth Signet]] or [[Celestial skill]]s if they were [[disable]]d by another skill (e.g. by [[Distracting Shot]]); it will not recharge them if they were used successfully.
* This skill is sometimes used by [[trapper]]s, as it allows them to plant another set of traps or [[nature rituals]] without waiting out the long recharge time.
* Combine with [[Determined Shot]], which recharges all your attack skills if it [[Fail#Skills that have an effect when an attack fails to hit|fails to hit]]. This can be used to rapidly recharge Oath Shot.
** This tactic can be extended with [[Shadow Sanctuary]], which almost guarantees a miss.
** Add [["Dodge This!"]] or [[Asuran Scan]] to the [[skill chain]] to ensure that Oath Shot hits through [[block]] and/or [[blind]], bear in mind it will still have a 50% chance to miss when below 8 Expertise.
* The 50% [[miss]] chance is actually a 50% [[fail]] chance and cannot be prevented with effects such as Asuran Scan. Oath Shot will still go into recharge, unlike in regular attack skill failure.
